kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost delete-database-account --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-account-id 9 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDatabaseAccount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host from which you want to delete the database account.

You can call the DescribeInstances operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除的数据库账户所在堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host from which you want to delete the database account.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除的数据库账户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database account that you want to delete.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758839.html operation to query the database account ID
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的数据库账户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758839.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: database_account_id
